label: run142 KEEPER outage-fix + ST_GAS
definition: KEEPER (supersedes run139). Two grounded fixes on the measured-2023 keeper: (1) the CAMPD outage detectors now drop economic-idle false outages via a revealed-availability filter (a down span is a real outage only if it overlaps the system's high-load p85 band) — removing the ~40-80 GW of economically-idle coal/CC the detectors flagged in low-demand shoulder/winter months, which the co-opt read as reserve shortfall and priced to VOLL; (2) ST_GAS committed offer restored from the run134 cooldown 0.525 to cost (~0.91). Result vs run139: mean monthly LMP MAE 10.6->7.7 (2023 12.1->10.9, 2024 13.2->8.9, 2025 6.5->3.3); the Oct/Apr VOLL over-fire is gone (Oct-2024 $73.7/17h->$25.4/3h) while real summer scarcity is preserved (Aug-2024 14h>$200 max $5000; 2023 Aug $139). ST_GAS over-dispatch corrected (+27%->near measured). KNOWN TRADEOFF: the fix cools avg strongly but THINS the tails (2024 21 vs actual 53 h>$200; 2025 1 vs 31) and annual-p85 under-weights winter (2024 Jan storm under-fired); a less-aggressive percentile or net-load signal would recover tail. 2023 remains under (structurally out-of-market, ~42% per run140). GATED: outage CSVs regenerated (cross-ISO rule; other ISOs need re-gating).
